faq.title: FAQ & Guides
faq.subtitle: Quick answers to common questions about GameForSmart features and gameplay.
faq.q1: How do I change my password or account email?
faq.a1: Go to your 'Profile' menu in the top right, then select 'Security & Account'. There you can update your password and recovery email.
faq.q2: What should I do if my account is locked?
faq.a2: Accounts are temporarily locked after multiple failed attempts. Wait 15 minutes or click 'Forgot Password'. If still unresolved, submit a ticket in the Support tab.
faq.q3: How do I create my own quiz?
faq.a3: Head to the 'Quiz' menu on the sidebar and click 'Create New Quiz'. You can write questions manually or use our 'AI Quiz Generator' to generate questions instantly.
faq.q4: How are points and XP calculated in GameForSmart?
faq.a4: Points depend on answer accuracy and response speed (faster correct answers earn streak bonuses). XP accumulates to level up your profile on the weekly leaderboard.
faq.q5: My quiz score is missing from the competition leaderboard?
faq.a5: Ensure the quiz session finished completely and your connection was active. Syncing takes a few seconds. If it doesn't show up after 5 minutes, open a technical ticket.
faq.q6: How do I invite friends to my Group?
faq.a6: Go to 'Groups' in the sidebar, open your group, and click 'Invite Members'. You can share the unique group code or direct invite link with your friends.
faq.q7: What if another player is cheating or using offensive words?
faq.a7: You can report them directly via the 'Violation Reports' tab. Include their username and screenshots so our Trust & Safety team can inspect and apply sanctions.
faq.q8: What are the differences between Free, Starter, Pro, and Enterprise?
faq.a8: Free offers standard quiz play. Starter unlocks advanced educational quizzes. Pro grants unlimited AI Generation & groups up to 100 members. Enterprise is tailored for schools with analytics and priority SLA.
faq.a9: We accept Credit/Debit cards (Visa, Mastercard), Bank Virtual Accounts, and major e-Wallets including GoPay, OVO, ShopeePay, and QRIS.
faq.a10: Refund requests can be submitted within 72 hours if you were charged twice or plan features failed to activate. Please open a ticket under 'Billing & Subscriptions'.
